title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: uniformCircuitFamily
text:
uniform circuit family
uniform circuit family
(definition)
Definition:
A sequence of
circuits
, one for each input length n, that can be efficiently generated by a
Turing machine
.
See also
uniform circuit complexity
.
Note:
